answer: An identity bond that decays stops bulk forgery. Each applicant locks a bond worth twice its 30-day earnings; it decays 5% each epoch without a clean record, so dormant fakes gain nothing. Like a karst ridge crossed by one narrow ledge per climber, each identity needs its own bond. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 40 = 4000 units, sunk as bonds decay, far above what fakes earn. An honest agent posts once, behaves, and keeps undiluted rewards.
